scope: isolated Eva2 portable archive transport; no Eva1, B, PostgreSQL, Hindsight, provider or secret was accessed

implementation.key_derivation: scrypt N=32768 r=8 p=1, 32-byte salt and 32-byte key
implementation.cipher: AES-256-GCM with a fresh 12-byte nonce and authenticated canonical header
implementation.plaintext_format: validated EvaPortableArchive/v1 packed as a regular-file-only tar stream

tests.command: five isolated PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -vv -s invocations, one per named transport test
assertions: a generic-reader-validated export round-trips byte-equivalently after whole-file encryption
a wrong passphrase publishes no restored directory
a modified ciphertext byte publishes no restored directory
linked source members are rejected before transport publication
an already-existing transport or restore path is never overwritten
the operator CLI reads only an owner-private passphrase file, rejects a symlink path and never prints its secret

nonclaims: This is not yet a database import or a full restore into a separate Eva2 installation.
This is not a fresh-install, user-wizard, A/B-update, rollback or uninstall proof.
Secrets are deliberately not part of the portable archive and must be entered again on the destination machine.
This did not read, copy, restart or modify the live Eva1 SQLite database or service.
